qualityFlags.A: Official value: Value provided as official when the source agency assigns sufficient confidence that it is not expected to be dramatically revised
qualityFlags.E: Estimate either calculated as sum or identify (yield) from official values or from an AQUASTAT estimation
qualityFlags.I: Imputed (carry forward, vertical imputation, linear interpolation)
qualityFlags.X: External value (reported by FAOSTAT or another international agency)

source.attribution: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), AQUASTAT
